notes.title: New Update for Call of Tomsk-7 2.5
notes.notes:
New Features:
* Ending added into game
* Controller option on the main menu
* New secret Hat available

Bug Fixes:
* Enemies no longer spawn on the player
* Music mute option fixed
* Decreased overall bug enemy spawn rate
* Spelling errors corrected
